newsitem.title: USA: AMBAC qualifies nine muni issues for insurance.
newsitem.headline: AMBAC qualifies nine muni issues for insurance.

text.p: AMBAC Indemnity Corp said Tuesday it qualified for bond insurance the following nine municipal issues scheduled for competitive sale today:
--Redding School District, Calif., $7.215 million general obligation bonds.
--Regional School District No 15, Conn., $8 million GOs.
--Sherburne County Housing, Minn., $5.96 million revenue bonds.
--Campbell-Savona Central School District, N.Y., $3.9 million GOs.
--Canisteo Central School District, N.Y., $9.8 million GOs.
--Noble County Independent School District No 1, Okla., $1.5 million building bonds.
--Brownsville, Texas, $5.01 million tax and revenue bonds.
